perceive_decide_act_confirm.procedure: perceive environment and target → decide to engage now → act to initiate and maintain close interaction

evaluate_select_confirm.procedure: recall criteria → perceive options → filter by criteria → select subset → execute choice

identify_improve_confirm.procedure: perceive spatial elements → determine relative positions → assign standardized labels → update internal representation → verify consistency without state change

explore_update_confirm.procedure: observe until stable feedback → confirm outputs → select safe stance → scan environment → cautiously advance maintaining safety

avoid_navigate_confirm.procedure: initiate rapid movement away from threat → hold position to allow threat displacement → observe environment to confirm threat absence

filter_count_report.procedure: identify target attribute → perceive all items → filter items by attribute → count filtered items → output count

initialize_setup.procedure: assess initial state → arrange elements for future use → verify stability of arrangement

sustain_action_under_threat.procedure: perceive threats and state changes → decide to maintain action despite risk → execute and sustain action → verify completion and continued presence

sequence_adjust_confirm.procedure: initiate action → adjust subsequent action to align → perform combined action → observe outcome and update state

plan_execute_confirm.procedure: identify goal → plan path → execute actions avoiding obstacles → verify progress → update state → remove irrelevant elements

perceive_identify_confirm.procedure: recognize task → perceive text region → identify target text → verify clarity → output exact text

copy_confirm_action.procedure: perceive source content → reproduce content in target → execute submission action → verify acceptance

solve_respond.procedure: perceive problem → compute solution → input answer → confirm submission

trace_identify_repair.procedure: trace sequence → identify break-point → select action to repair or extend sequence → avoid disruptive actions → execute and verify improvement

combine_simplify_verify.procedure: identify given relations → combine equations to eliminate variables → select simplified expression → verify consistency with constraints

detect_time_execute.procedure: detect target in path → assess readiness → execute timed action → verify successful outcome
